propositions: The dedup key is computed from a prediction of the wire the send path will produce, rather than from the actual bytes sent, and drifts when the three independently-maintained fit compositions diverge

Two mutation-enactment consumers (create at dispatch_one.py:368-379 and update at dispatch_apply_phases.py:377-386) must both read wire_body and send it to the transport, so the key is derived from bytes identical to what reaches the adapter
Re-fitting an already-fitted body must return it byte-identical (idempotent on both Cloud and DC fitters) so the adapter's defensive fit cannot move bytes after the key is taken
The mutation entry must carry both wire_body and the original body, with consumers reading wire_body or falling back to body for pre-cutover entries without wire_body

fit_for_send must be added to outbound_comments.py as a frozen dataclass that returns both landed_text (the dedup key, byte-identical to today's compare_body) and wire_body (what the transport receives)
The fit_comment port contract and both implementers must remain unchanged; fit_comment_as_sent is retained as a wrapper over fit_for_send to preserve the Protocol signature
